outcome: progress of labour (partograph zones, active phase duration)
delivery outcome (birth weight, APGAR score at 1st and 5th minute, NICU admission, fetal distress)
cohort: The study included 200 subjects, divided equally into an induced labor group and a spontaneous labor group.
finding: The induced labor group exhibited a significantly longer active phase duration compared to the spontaneous labor group.
mod_finding: Induced labor was associated with a longer active phase duration compared to spontaneous labor, which is a key aspect of the mode of birth process.
cross-section timing: Data was collected over a two-year period, with observations focused on labor progression and immediate delivery outcomes.
birth_weight: Induced group: 2.74 +/- 0.42 Kgs; Spontaneous group: 2.63 +/- 0.39 Kgs
